basis: All 64 park records reviewed against the existing sourced seasonal-access dataset; major candidate NPS pages rechecked. Monthly classifications are modeled guidance for an ordinary road/highlights trip, not legal closure dates.
monthPolicy: Major months are core restricted months; transition months may contain both restricted and accessible dates. Weather-dependent boundaries must be checked for the travel year. Temporary alerts and construction dates are not repeated annually.
